data.label: Atmokinesis
data.description: That damage becomes air () or bolt (), and its source deals extra damage equal to (2 + the number of filled sections in your Brainwave Clock).

data.label: Clairvoyance
data.description: Ask the Game Master a single question about that NPC, which the Game Master must answer truthfully. Then, describe what sensation revealed this information to you. You may use this gift only once on each NPC.
data.event: When an NPC becomes your focus or when you create a Bond towards an NPC

data.label: Gravitokinesis
data.description: That damage becomes earth () or physical (), and its source deals extra damage equal to (2 + the number of filled sections in your Brainwave Clock). If the source deals damage to one or more flying creatures, they are forced to land immediately.

data.label: Life Transference
data.description: Choose yourself or an ally who is your focus: if the chosen creature is in Crisis, they recover an amount of Hit Points equal to (5 + (the number of filled sections in your Brainwave Clock, multiplied by 5)).
data.event: When you cause one or more enemies to lose HP

data.label: Photokinesis
data.description: That damage becomes dark () or light (), and its source deals extra damage equal to (2 + the number of filled sections in your Brainwave Clock).

data.label: Psychic Backlash
data.description: That enemy loses an amount of Mind Points equal to (5 + (the number of filled sections in your Brainwave Clock, multiplied by 5)). Then, choose one option: that enemy suffers dazed, or that enemy suffers shaken.
data.event: After an enemy succeeds on an Opposed Check against you or causes you to lose Hit Points

data.label: Psychic Shield
data.description: For the purposes of that Check, you may treat your Defense and Magic Defense scores as being equal to (your current Willpower die size + (the number of filled sections in your Brainwave Clock, multiplied by 2)). You may still use your normal scores if better.
data.event: After an enemy you can see performs an Accuracy Check or a Magic Check

data.label: Reassuring Presence
data.description: That ally recovers an amount of Mind Points equal to (10 + (the number of filled sections in your Brainwave Clock, multiplied by 5)). If that ally is your focus, they recover from a single status effect of their choice out of dazed, enraged, and shaken.
data.event: After you cover an ally with the Guard action

data.label: Thermokinesis
data.description: That damage becomes fire () or ice (), and its source deals extra damage equal to (2 + the number of filled sections in your Brainwave Clock).
